quest.title: Chisato's Letter
quest.description: Chisato, lady of the Hiiragi Clan, which leads the Kanjou Commission, requests that you help her bring a letter to her sweetheart, Kujou Kamaji...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

talks.objective: Give the letter to Kujou Kamaji

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: You are... Ahh, you're that Traveler from abroad. What can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Hiiragi Chisato's Letter...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: This letter... Did Ms. Hiiragi really ask you to deliver this letter to me?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: This handwriting... It really is her... Thank goodness...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Thank you for making this trip, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: As for the Travel Permit... As it's Ms. Hiiragi's personal request, I will naturally see it through.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: However, I'll need some time to prepare...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: How about this. Can you wait for me at the Kiminami Restaurant?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you want to go there?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Well... I want a small favor from you.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Recently... I was also thinking of sending something to Ms. Hiiragi.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: I wrote a letter and also requested Ms. Kiminami to make some treats for me. I was planning to send them together to Ms. Hiiragi as a present.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: But if my father finds out about my plans, he might be upset... Just as I was pondering what to do, you showed up.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: Father doesn't want me to communicate with Ms. Hiiragi.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: I understand his concerns. After all, I am a member of the Kujou Clan and one of the enforcers of the Tenryou Commission.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: Ms. Hiiragi is the young lady of the Kanjou Commission's Hiiragi Clan.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: If I were to get too close to her, it would be inevitable that someone might try to take advantage of our situation.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: Even though it is only a present, in some people's eyes, it's a lot more than that.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: Hehe, let's not talk about these trivial matters.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: Traveler, please wait at the Kiminami Restaurant for me. After I approve the Travel Permit, I'll bring it to you.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: Father... He naturally has to be strict. I do understand why he's unwilling for me to communicate with Ms. Hiiragi.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: After all, I am a member of the Kujou Clan and one of the enforcers of the Tenryou Commission.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: Ms. Hiiragi is the young lady of the Kanjou Commission's Hiiragi Clan.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: If I were to get too close to her, it would be inevitable that someone might try to take advantage of our situation.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: Even though it is only a present, in some people's eyes, it's a lot more than that.

talks.objective: Give the letter to Kujou Kamaji

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: *sigh* What a headache... Hi there, is there anything you want?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Kamaji...

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: Are you talking about Master Kamaji? What do you want from him?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Show Chisato's Letter)

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: You said this letter is from Ms. Hiiragi Chisato?

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: If this letter is really from that Hiiragi Chisato...

dialogues.speaker: Sanada
dialogues.text: I think... You should talk to Master Kamaji directly. He's been taking walks near the bridge recently.

talks.objective: Go to Kiminami Restaurant to collect the snacks

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Welcome to Kiminami Restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Kamaji's treats...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Oh, I've already prepared the treats that Master Kamaji ordered. I'll bring them to you now.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: But, I'm curious about who Master Kamaji will give these treats to...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: It's nothing more than a public relations gesture, Ms. Kiminami.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: A while back, Mr. Hiiragi Shinsuke presented my father with a batch of fine tea.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: My father knows that Mr. Hiiragi's beloved daughter Chisato likes treats, so he told me to prepare some as a gift in return.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: I was worried that the delivery might take too long, and there might also be unavoidable bumps during the journey... So I specifically asked for this Traveler to deliver them.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Ms. Kiminami, can I have a look at the treats, please? I want to make sure I haven't missed anything.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Hmm... Sure, here are the treats. Please take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Everything is there. Thank you, Ms. Kiminami.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Let us move out of the way, Traveler. I have a few more things to say to you.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: This is the Travel Permit. Please take it.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: With this Travel Permit, you can freely enter and leave Ritou.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: It's fine. This permit will make your delivery a lot smoother.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Also... Here's the letter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you write this letter yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Yes. I tried to write this letter in a... tactful manner. I hope Ms. Hiiragi won't be offended by it.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Please deliver this letter and the treats to Ms. Hiiragi.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do we have to go back again...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Hehe, but this time, you have the Travel Permit. You should have a lot more freedom than before.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: I'll leave it to you, Traveler. I also need to go back and deal with official matters.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Ugh, when will I be able to go there myself...

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Traveler, you've returned.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: I guess you've delivered my letter to Kamaji? ...Did you manage to get the Travel Permit as well?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: You don't have to thank me. You should be thanking Kamaji instead.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Eh? What's this? Treats, and... a handwritten letter from Kamaji?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Was it his request? These Tricolor Dango... He prepared them for me...

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Thank you, Traveler. I'll make sure to savor these treats. As for this letter... I'll read it with great care.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Thank you for the hard work. Please, accept these items as thanks for your help.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Who knows... I might need your help again in the future as well.
